The Burg Research Habitat off Little Hardin Island — GTA 6 guide

Reported by a published guide · not personally verified Seabed east of the south end of Little Hardin Island, near Waning Sands

A big yellow buoy off Little Hardin Island is not marking a shipping lane.

Full guide — contains spoilers

On the seabed east of the south end of Little Hardin Island stands a yellow underwater lab marked BURG, resembling the real Aquarius reef station; a large yellow buoy floats above it. Swim underneath and climb up through the floor opening. Inside are a dive locker, galley, bunks and a laptop holding chats between Facilities 1, 3 and 4 — one researcher complains he is hunting meteors because of a billionaire's mid-life crisis. Visiting counts toward Underwater Discoveries, and there is loot in the galley.

Source & evidence

Source: GTA 6 Kraken Location and Other Underwater Secrets — GTA Culture (2026-11-22).

Evidence: Checked against a creator's gameplay video, with interior description. Single-video source for this particular habitat in the page checked.
